data.heading: I thrive on transforming complex challenges into elegant simplicity. When I’m not architecting code or refining pixels, you’ll find me exploring the art of cooking.
data.intro: I’m a front-end developer based in Gurgaon, currently a Senior Engineer at Evalueserve, where I build enterprise dashboards in Vue that stay quick under large, high-frequency datasets. Across {experience} I’ve worked the whole front-end stack — HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Angular and Vue — mostly on internal tools and data-heavy interfaces, the kind that have to keep working on a slow connection and a small screen as well as they do in a demo.
data.content1: I don’t just define myself by past achievements, but by the impact I aim to create next. While skills are learned, a resilient personality is built. I am committed to a path of lifelong growth, constantly challenging myself to build things that matter.
data.content2: My natural energy drives a deep interest in diverse hobbies, from fine arts to evolving tech. Being a fast learner allows me to adapt quickly across multifaceted roles. I strive to merge multi-disciplinary expertise throughout my career, ensuring every project I lead is both functional and inspired.
data.heading2: I’m always open to meaningful conversations and new creative collaborations.
